trend: FSSAI asks energy drinks to relabel as 'caffeinated beverages'; Oct advisory on nutraceutical labels
why: Label honesty is in the news, and full disclosure is the thing SILT is built on.
text:
FSSAI wants energy drinks relabelled as caffeinated beverages. Good. A label should tell you what's inside in milligrams.

SILT Mornings has 80 mg caffeine and 200 mg L-theanine per stick, no proprietary blend, and a lab report for all 19 ingredients. Ask us about any of it.
